description: Reviewed CI ratchet deltas for intentional functionality added before the architecture snapshots were refreshed. Every allowance is exact so unrelated growth or routes still fail. The route-manifest additions were folded into config/route-manifest.json on 2026-08-05 and again when the earlier Golden Coast phases reached main, so those lists only contain exact reviewed deltas since that snapshot: the three Phase 7 sales-cash-transfer middleware mounts introduced by the Phase 16 HADI transfer guard. config/source-text-assertion-baseline.json was regenerated once audit-source-text-assertions learned to see relative-URL source reads, so every test previously carried here as a reviewed delta now lives in that baseline, which is the canonical list. The four source-text allowances are assertions that landed on main after that baseline was taken, each on a test the baseline already records: one from #1193 in server/routes/sp/spGoldenCoastPhase11MonthlyCloseRoutes.test.ts pinning the shared-charge Decimal expression, and three from #1196 in tests/supplier-partner-net-position-inclusion.test.ts pinning the residual-formula constant, the freshStartResidual computation and the sp_hadi_intercompany skip.
